# Netflix Canada
> Stream Netflix movies, TV shows, documentaries, and mobile games across web, TV, and mobile devices.

Netflix is a subscription streaming service with consumer support, account management, legal information, media resources, and a dedicated site for developers building Netflix experiences.

## Watch & Browse
- [Netflix Canada Home](https://www.netflix.com/ca/): Main Canadian landing page for browsing and starting Netflix streaming.
- [Browse Titles](https://www.netflix.com/browse): Browse Netflix movies and TV shows by category and availability.
- [Latest](https://www.netflix.com/latest): Discover newly added and trending titles on Netflix.
- [Kids](https://www.netflix.com/Kids): Family-friendly viewing area with children’s movies and TV shows.
- [Audio and Subtitles](https://www.netflix.com/browse/audio): Browse titles by available audio languages and subtitle options.

## Account & Subscription
- [Your Account](https://www.netflix.com/YourAccount): Manage membership, billing, profile, and playback settings.
- [Login](https://www.netflix.com/login): Sign in to an existing Netflix account.
- [Signup](https://www.netflix.com/signup): Start a new Netflix membership and choose a plan.
- [Redeem Gift Cards](https://www.netflix.com/redeem): Redeem a Netflix gift card or promo code.
- [Gift Cards](https://www.netflix.com/gift-cards): Learn about Netflix gift cards, redemption, and participating retailers.

## Help Center
- [Help Center Home](https://help.netflix.com/): Main support hub for troubleshooting, billing, and account questions.
- [How to Sign Up for Netflix](https://help.netflix.com/en/node/412): Steps for creating an account and starting a membership.
- [How to Change Your Plan](https://help.netflix.com/en/node/22): Instructions for switching between available Netflix plans.
- [How to Cancel Netflix](https://help.netflix.com/en/node/407): Official guidance for canceling a Netflix membership.
- [Netflix Supported Devices](https://help.netflix.com/en/node/14361): Device compatibility information for TVs, phones, tablets, and computers.
- [How to Download Titles to Watch Offline](https://help.netflix.com/en/node/54816): Learn how downloads work on supported mobile devices.
- [Parental Controls on Netflix](https://help.netflix.com/en/node/264): Set maturity ratings, profile locks, and viewing restrictions.
- [Contact Us](https://help.netflix.com/en/contactus): Reach Netflix support through available contact options.

## Devices & Apps
- [Netflix on Smart TVs and Streaming Media Players](https://help.netflix.com/en/node/14361): Supported television and streaming hardware for watching Netflix.
- [Netflix on Android Phones and Tablets](https://help.netflix.com/en/node/57688): Setup and troubleshooting for the Android Netflix app.
- [Netflix on iPhone, iPad, and iPod touch](https://help.netflix.com/en/node/57689): Setup and support information for iOS and iPadOS devices.
- [Netflix on Windows Computers or Tablets](https://help.netflix.com/en/node/23931): Watch Netflix on Windows through browser or app options.
- [Netflix on Mac Computers](https://help.netflix.com/en/node/55764): Browser-based playback guidance for Mac users.
- [Netflix on Set-top Boxes](https://help.netflix.com/en/node/14362): Support details for cable boxes and set-top devices.

## Features & Experience
- [Profiles](https://help.netflix.com/en/node/322532): Create and manage separate viewing profiles for household members.
- [Netflix Kids Experience](https://help.netflix.com/en/node/264): Use parental controls and kid-friendly profile settings.
- [Subtitles, Captions, and Audio](https://help.netflix.com/en/node/372): Manage subtitle appearance and audio language preferences.
- [Playback Settings](https://help.netflix.com/en/node/87): Control data usage and autoplay behavior for profiles.
- [Downloads](https://help.netflix.com/en/node/54816): Save supported titles for offline viewing on mobile devices.
- [Netflix Games](https://help.netflix.com/en/node/121442): Learn about accessing and playing Netflix mobile games.

## Developer Platform
- [Netflix for Developers](https://netflix.github.io/): Developer portal for Netflix open source projects and platform resources.
- [Open Source Software Center](https://netflix.github.io/): Entry point to Netflix engineering open source tools and libraries.
- [ConsoleMe](https://netflix.github.io/consoleme/): Self-service permissions and cloud access management platform from Netflix.
- [Dispatch](https://netflix.github.io/dispatch/): Incident management framework for response coordination and workflows.
- [Metaflow](https://netflix.github.io/metaflow/): Human-friendly framework for data science and machine learning workflows.
- [Polynote](https://netflix.github.io/polynote/): Polyglot notebook environment for data analysis and experimentation.
- [Security Monkey](https://netflix.github.io/security_monkey/): Monitoring tool for security and configuration changes in cloud environments.
- [Zuul](https://netflix.github.io/zuul/): Edge service framework for routing, monitoring, and resilience patterns.

## Company & Media
- [Netflix Media Center](https://media.netflix.com/): Official newsroom with press releases, assets, and company announcements.
- [About Netflix](https://about.netflix.com/): Corporate information, leadership, culture, and business updates.
- [Newsroom](https://about.netflix.com/en/news): Company news, product updates, and corporate announcements.
- [Careers](https://jobs.netflix.com/): Explore job openings, teams, and working at Netflix.
- [Brand Site](https://brand.netflix.com/): Official brand guidelines, logos, and creative assets.

## Legal & Policies
- [Terms of Use](https://help.netflix.com/legal/termsofuse): Legal terms governing use of the Netflix service.
- [Privacy Statement](https://help.netflix.com/legal/privacy): Privacy practices for Netflix accounts, devices, and services.
- [Cookie Preferences](https://www.netflix.com/ca/cookiepreferences): Manage cookie consent and related preferences for Netflix.
- [Corporate Information](https://help.netflix.com/legal/corpinfo): Corporate entity and company information by region.
- [Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information](https://www.netflix.com/ca/privacyoptout): Privacy choice page for applicable jurisdictions.
- [Legal Notices](https://help.netflix.com/legal/notices): Third-party notices and additional legal disclosures.
